text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan showed hints of frustration 
over missing victory. Yet, having 
completed the Satsuki Sho, her steps 
remained steady and resolute—a testament 
to how much she had grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using this race as fuel for growth, Mejiro 
Ardan vows renewed determination to 
deliver results in the Aoba Sho and the 
Nippon Derby beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono 
O also drew strength from the Satsuki 
Sho's results, rallying themselves to 
seize victory in the Japanese Derby.
